verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay ships self-hostable relay software and runs a public test relay, so asking about a vendor uptime SLA and status page is fair. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a published SLA, uptime commitment or public status page. Scale and failover claims describe architecture, not a vendor reliability commitment, so they do not count here.

support.subject: As a founder, the vendor publishes an uptime SLA and a public status page I can check during an incident
